hooks.name: Rust Delivery Closeout
hooks.description: Prompts a concise completion audit for changed Rust Factory work.

action.prompt: If product or configuration files changed in this session, perform a concise delivery closeout against `.kiro/steering/rust-delivery-workflow.md`: identify any missing required reviewer decision, validation command, spec/README/API update, or GitHub issue follow-up. Do not run commands, create issues, or repeat checks automatically. Be silent if no action is needed.
